title: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery in Astrophysics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the scoring patterns of different LLM-as-a-Judge models (OpenAI and Gemini) against human expert evaluations to identify systematic scoring biases (conservative underrating vs. optimistic overrating) and investigating potential self-preference bias where models might prefer responses generated by their own underlying architectures.
